messages:
sara: Quick sync — I pushed the metrics deck for the runtime/dashboard work: kv_cache_hit_ratio, tail_latency_95, inflight_requests_by_tenant, token_rate_per_tenant. We need alerting rules + pager routing before we flip the dashboard to 7d retention. Anyone owning alert semantics?

devin: I can take ownership of the policy shape (platform). Runtime team owns the metric instrumentation. Suggestion: page on SLO burn (burn_rate > 4 for 15m) but emit a warning at 5m first. Keeps noise down.

kevin: SG. Note: token_rate spikes during cold starts for some large models — we'll get transient burns. Can we follow a "slow-burn" pattern: only page on sustained burn (e.g. burn_rate > 6 for 15m) OR if error_rate also elevated. Also, please ensure metrics carry labels: model_variant and tenant_id (we need these for dedup + routing).

jamie: For pager routing I'd prefer runtime-oncall primary, platform secondary. Add annotations to alerts with runbook + immediate mitigations (scale pool, fallback to smaller model, enable prefix cache). For dedup/fingerprint use: tenant_id + model_variant.

maria: Oncall mapping: runtime rotation A -> platform rotation B. If primary acknowledges but not resolved in 30m escalate to infra-sre. Also, suppress per-tenant paging if >50 tenants firing (flip to aggregate incident).

devin: Draft alert example (will put in PR):
```
ALERT SLOBurnHigh
  IF slo_burn_rate{service="runtime"} > 6
  FOR 15m
  LABELS { severity="page", team="eng-runtime" }
  ANNOTATIONS { summary="SLO burn >6 (15m)", runbook="https://wiki.redwood/runtimes/oncall-runbook#slo-burn" }
```
Link PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/452

kevin: tweak: use severity=warning for burn 3-6, page only >6. For tail latency, page only if p95 > 1200ms AND error_rate > 0.5% (avoid paging on noisy p95 spikes).

sara: Can someone add the dashboard panels with the alert annotations? Wants: SLO burn panel (time series + burn-rate heatmap) and a per-tenant inflight heatmap. We'll canary the UX to 10% of customers.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: infra/alerts PR #452 merged by devops-ci at 2124009900 :white_check_mark:

jamie: I updated PagerDuty routing: runtime primary, platform backup, infra-sre escalation at 30m. Added runbook stub (will expand). Runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runtimes/oncall-runbook#slo-burn

maria: :thumbsup: I'll monitor first 24h after flip. Also please add an aggregate (non-paging) alert that triggers when >50 tenants are firing so SEs are notified and we don't spam oncall.

devin: Good call — adding both aggregate + per-tenant but default per-tenant is non-paging unless sustained. PR updated with aggregation and suppression rules: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/alerts/pull/452/files

sara: :eyes: thanks everyone. Let's do a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT to finalize thresholds, routing, and the canary plan.
